summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, 4 cells per level) and imports Measurement; rich/align.py adds the Align width constraint (measured max, capped by explicit width), Align.__repr__, and a public VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr; rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as UNRELEASED with an Added section containing the two entries; tests/test_align.py adds repr, render, and measure tests for VerticalCenter and Align; tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a measure test expecting Measurement(11, 19). All changes were verified by reading only, since tests were not run as instructed.
